goal: Close round-14's five musts without inventing new falsehoods, and kill the user-reported defect he called «this is not ok» — the Gupshup sandbox activation phrase «proxy <botname>» reaching the model as the customer's first message. Underneath all of it, the standing bar from user-model R2: what the board shows him must be REAL. Weighting for this round, set by the founder's own calendar: he demos to his team TODAY, so the test is what would embarrass him on screen, not process debt.
headline: Four of five musts are genuinely closed and I want that on the record first, because this is the strongest round since I started gating: M1b is the best piece of design work in five rounds — I read computed styles myself at 1440 and 375 and an assistant reading is now transparent + dashed + font-weight 600 + a literal «قراءة» marker against a tool-written tag's solid #ECFDF3 fill + solid border + weight 700, i.e. three independent non-hue channels, identical at both viewports, zero console errors. M3 is right in every part I could test: ts is preserved per unchanged product, db.replaceTags is one BEGIN/COMMIT with ROLLBACK and a released client, memory mutates only after the DB promise resolves, and POST /admin/contact/tags returned 404 on an unknown phone with the contact count unchanged at 20 (401 without the token). ياسمين's «سجل التفاعل» now opens on her own delivery event at ٠٩:٥١ ص and her interest tag sits at ٠٨:٥٠ ص anchored to «تنسيق عرض موجز» with the meta «قراءة من هذه الرسالة» — round-13's M1(d) is finally shut. M4 I falsified rather than read: I swapped the #customer landmark for an impossible string and the guard printed FAIL and exited 1; the real run is 7/7 routes, exit 0; and the wiring exists in package.json, CLAUDE.md §4 and the domain skill §5. M5 is the one I expected to reject for a fourth time and could not: I re-hashed all twelve pairs and FOUR are genuinely different files at exactly the claimed ratios, with baselines stamped 11:54:57Z (frozen at 9b7cd54) against actuals stamped 12:45–12:46Z (after f6ab762). That is the first real pixel comparison this project has ever produced. The eight zeros each carry an honest baseline_note, and the one that smells laundered — wizard@375, byte-identical, note claiming «real comparison» — is TRUE on inspection: its baseline predates its actual by 51 minutes so it cannot be a copy; the page simply did not change. Fifth round on the 375 stepper: I opened v-salespath-375x812.png BY EYE and the current stage IS in it — «معالجة الاعتراض» as a dark-filled node, centred, with «عرض الحل ✓» behind it — and live at 375 the chip reads «المرحلة ٥ من ٦» in Arabic-Indic. Closed. What I cannot accept is two things the founder will see on screen today. First: the catalogue clamp works — «باقات NVR لتغطية 8 مواقع» and «خدمات لِين الأخرى» are gone from /admin/insights, from #home and from the #kmon/9 chip, and all 14 cached rows now hold only catalogue names — but the sentinel itself was renamed, not removed, and «خدمة أخرى: ١ مكتسبة · ٠ غير مكتسبة» is a row on «لماذا نكسب — ولماذا نخسر». That is round-14's M1(c) verbatim, third round running, on the flagship board, and it is a one-line filter. A market-verdict-BY-SERVICE board cannot render a verdict for a bucket defined as «not a service»; it is either noise that teaches him to distrust the board or a number he misreads as signal. Second, and this is the one that decides the verdict: the Proxy fix is forward-only. I pulled all four real transcripts from the live API. Every one still opens «Proxy Massar» → «هل تقصدون خدمة أو منتجًا باسم «Proxy Massar»؟»; Ibrahim's — his single «صفقة مكتسبة» and the hero of the demo — still escalates a human handoff for that non-existent service; and 966543464327's still carries the literal «**بروكسي مسار**» with the asterisks WhatsApp renders raw. These are not archived, they render today in «سجل التفاعل» on the client-360 page. He said «this is not ok» about exactly this text and exactly this text is still on the screen he will project. The leak is closed; the spill was never wiped. The fix is ten lines and destroys nothing: reuse the SANDBOX_ACTIVATION matcher that already exists at the transcript/timeline RENDER boundary, collapse the activation exchange behind «تفعيل المنصة — لا يخص العميل», and strip `**` on the way out. No data deletion, no §8 approval, no send.

scope_verification.item: M1(a) — canonicalService() clamps on parse, in winLossBoard, and at the read boundary
scope_verification.evidence: insights.ts now exports SERVICE_CATALOGUE (6 names) + OTHER_SERVICE + a 6-entry ordered SERVICE_PATTERNS table, canonicalService() (exact match → ordered regex containment → OTHER_SERVICE) and normalizeCached() (map + dedupe). All three call sites present in the diff: getInsights parse (`.map(p => ({product: canonicalService(...)}))`), winLossBoard (`[...new Set(products.map(canonicalService))]`), and BOTH read boundaries in index.ts — GET /admin/insights wraps every row in normalizeCached, GET /admin/customer/:phone wraps getInsights. The pattern order is deliberate and correct: «الربط مع سجل التطعيمات الوطني» hits تطعيم (index 1) before تكامل|ربط (index 5), so a phrase naming two nouns resolves to its subject.

scope_verification.item: M1 — honesty ruling 1: does folding «باقات NVR لتغطية 8 مواقع» into «خدمات التطعيمات» LAUNDER a signal the agent refused in-transcript?
scope_verification.verdict: NO — and I checked the transcript rather than reasoning about it
scope_verification.evidence: I read Ibrahim's live record end to end. The specific evidence SURVIVES verbatim on his client-360 page: the summary still says «وطلب عرضًا تعريفيًا لباقات NVR لتغطية 8 مواقع»; the buy-signal list still quotes «وش يصلح لي من باقات ال NVR» and «عدد المواقع ٨»; the next action still reads «مراجعة عرض الأسعار لباقات NVR لثمانية مواقع»; and the transcript still carries the agent's own refusal «باقات NVR غير متاحة لدي ضمن المعلومات المعتمدة، وقد أحلت استفساركم…». Only the GROUPING KEY was normalised — which is what a grouping key is for. Round-14 established (correcting round-13) that NVR here is «السجل الوطني للتطعيمات», an approved Lean service and one of three permitted {{1}} values in VOICE-REFERENCE.md:20-22, so «خدمات التطعيمات» is the truthful catalogue name for what he asked about, not a euphemism. The interest was real: he wrote «لا خلاص بشتري». VERDICT: not laundering; the specific stays on the client page, the general goes to the aggregate, which is the correct split. WHAT IS GENUINELY LOST is different and worth its own order: there is now no surface anywhere that says the agent hit a knowledge-base gap on the highest-intent conversation in the system. That signal never lived in product_interest, so the clamp did not remove it — but it is the single most commercially valuable fact in these four transcripts and it is invisible. Filed as S1.

scope_verification.item: M1 — honesty ruling 2: should «خدمة أخرى» appear as a row on a market-verdict-by-service board?
scope_verification.evidence: «لماذا نكسب — ولماذا نخسر» answers one question: which SERVICES win and which lose. It cannot answer that for a bucket whose definition is «not one of our services». «خدمة أخرى: ١ مكتسبة» is therefore either noise he must learn to ignore — which trains him to distrust the one board he is proudest of — or a number he reads as a market signal, which is false. Worse, it is not even null: it is a genuinely useful counter wearing the wrong costume. «٣ محادثات سألت عن خدمة خارج الكتالوج» under a KB-gap heading is real intelligence; «خدمة أخرى: ١ مكتسبة» under a win/loss heading is not. Drop OTHER_SERVICE from by_product and from interest chips, and surface the count once, honestly, elsewhere.

scope_verification.item: M1b — an assistant reading cannot pass as a confirmed tag; holds at 375 and without hue
scope_verification.evidence: My own Playwright pass over #kmon/9, reading getComputedStyle on every .chip inside #body, at 1440x900 AND 375x812 — byte-identical results at both. Reading chips: class «chip c-read c-ok», backgroundColor rgba(0,0,0,0), borderTopStyle DASHED, fontWeight 600, text «قراءة\nخدمات التطعيمات · نية مرتفعة». Tool-written tag one row below: class «chip c-ok», backgroundColor rgb(236,253,243), borderTopStyle SOLID, fontWeight 700, text «تكامل الأنظمة (HIS/ERP) · نية مرتفعة». The distinction rides three independent channels — FILL (transparent vs solid), BORDER STYLE (dashed vs solid) and a LITERAL ARABIC WORD («قراءة») — none of which is hue; the hue is retained only so the level still reads at a glance, which is the right call. Survives greyscale, survives a screenshot, survives touch, needs no hover. The title attribute is kept and improved («… قراءة المساعد من نص المحادثة، لم تُسجَّل كوسم مؤكد») but is no longer load-bearing. The intent-only fallback branch («نية مرتفعة» / «اهتمام مبدئي») also got c-read. 0 console errors at both viewports. This is the strongest single piece of work in the round.

scope_verification.item: M2 — one definition of «مؤهل» per screen; does the rename RESOLVE the contradiction or RELOCATE it?
scope_verification.verdict: PASS — it resolves it, and it is the mature call
scope_verification.evidence: dashboard.ts:595 now emits «ابدأ التواصل مع » + fmtN(hotHere.length) + « جهة تستحق المتابعة» with the subtitle «وسوم اهتمام مؤكدة، أو نية مرتفعة قرأها المساعد من نص المحادثة ولم تُسجَّل وسمًا بعد». RULING: hotHere and interestedOf measure genuinely different populations — one counts confirmed tags and human outcomes, the other also trusts an untagged high-intent reading. Forcing them equal, which round-14 offered as the first option, would have DESTROYED a real signal: a high-intent reading with no tag yet is precisely the person you call next. The honest fix for two different measurements is two different words plus a disclosed definition at the point of reading, and that is exactly what landed. The word «مهتمة» is no longer shared, the missing space after «مع» is fixed, and the count routes through fmtN so it renders ٢ beside «جهات مهتمة لكل ١٠٠». This is not relocation — a relocated contradiction would be two undisclosed definitions under two vague words; this is one disclosed definition per number, which is what user-model R4 asks of every intelligence surface.

scope_verification.item: M3(a) — tracker.replaceTags preserves ts; db.replaceTags is transactional; memory mutates after the DB
scope_verification.evidence: tracker.ts: `const prior = new Map((c.tags||[]).map(t => [t.product, t.ts]))` then `ts: t.ts ?? prior.get(t.product) ?? Date.now()` — an unchanged product keeps its original timestamp, an explicitly supplied ts wins, only a genuinely new product gets a fresh stamp. `Date.now()` no longer runs unconditionally. db.ts: `pool.connect()` → BEGIN → DELETE → N INSERTs → COMMIT, with `catch { ROLLBACK.catch(()=>{}) ; throw }` and `finally { client.release() }` — one client, one transaction, no leak, the throw propagates. Ordering in tracker.ts is `await db.replaceTags(phone, next)` BEFORE `c.tags = next`, so a DB failure leaves memory agreeing with the ledger rather than drifting ahead of it. Round-14's S1 is fully absorbed.

scope_verification.item: M3 — edge-case ruling: a tag with NO preceding customer message is now DROPPED from the timeline entirely. Acceptable?
scope_verification.verdict: NO — but it is a should, not a must
scope_verification.evidence: The `if (spoken)` has no else branch, so the tag silently vanishes from «سجل التفاعل» for any contact who never sent a message (a curated tag on a target who only ever received a blast). WHY IT IS NOT A MUST: the tag still exists everywhere else the founder looks — the interest chips, «فهم المساعد», the tags API, the ledger — so no evidence is destroyed, only one row is not rendered; and all four real contacts have customer messages, so nothing is missing on today's demo (I confirmed each of the four renders its tags correctly). WHY IT IS STILL WRONG: the card's own caption promises «كل نقاط التماس — رسائل، حالات تسليم، وسوم، ملفات — الأحدث أولًا». The code now contradicts a caption that explicitly lists وسوم. A surface that silently omits a category it advertises is the same honesty failure as a surface that invents one, just quieter. The fix is an else branch rendering the tag at its own ts in the distinct lane the comment already imagines, labelled «وسم مُسجَّل — لا رسالة عميل مرتبطة». Filed as S3.

scope_verification.item: NEW/M6 — the Proxy fix: does the code-level matcher work, and what is its false-positive risk?
scope_verification.evidence: SANDBOX_ACTIVATION = /^\s*(?:proxy\b|بروكسي(?:\s|$))[\s\S]{0,40}$/i, tested in handleInbound before anything reaches the model. I ran my OWN 18-case matrix rather than trusting the claimed 16/16. ZERO hard failures on the claimed behaviours: «proxy Massar», «proxy massar», «PROXY MASSAR», padded, «بروكسي مسار», bare «بروكسي», bare «proxy» all match; «مرحبا», a real Arabic first message, «نعم», and — critically — «إيقاف», «ايقاف» and «stop» all correctly do NOT match, so the check running BEFORE isOptOut cannot swallow an opt-out. The Arabic-boundary comment is right and needed: JS \b is ASCII-only, so «بروكسي» genuinely requires its own whitespace/end anchor. THREE FALSE POSITIVES FOUND: «proxy server عندنا يمنع الاتصال», «Proxy settings for HIS?» and «بروكسي الشبكة يمنع الربط مع النظام» all match — short, real, technical messages an IT manager at a healthcare facility could plausibly send. Compounding it, the matcher runs on EVERY inbound, not only the first: mid-conversation such a message makes the agent abandon the thread and reply with a cold-open greeting, which is conversation-destroying. Low probability, high blast radius, and the fix is one clause — gate the matcher on the contact having no prior customer message. Filed as S2.

user_impact_summary:
الحكم: **إعادة تكرار قصيرة** — أربعة من خمسة مطالب مغلقة فعليًا، وبقي بندان يظهران على الشاشة اليوم.

**ما أصبح صحيحًا (تحققتُ منه بنفسي، لا من التقرير):**
- **قراءة المساعد لم تعد تشبه الحقيقة.** الوسم المؤكد ممتلئ بلون ثابت وحد متصل ووزن ٧٠٠؛ قراءة المساعد شفافة بحد متقطّع ووزن ٦٠٠ وكلمة «قراءة» مكتوبة. ثلاث إشارات مستقلة لا تعتمد على اللون، ومتطابقة على ١٤٤٠ وعلى ٣٧٥. أفضل عمل في خمس جولات.
- **أسماء الخدمات انضبطت.** «باقات NVR لتغطية 8 مواقع» و«خدمات لِين الأخرى» اختفتا من كل الشاشات؛ الأربعة عشر سجلًا كلها الآن بأسماء الكتالوج.
- **التصحيح لم يعد يزوّر التاريخ.** وسم ياسمين عاد إلى ٠٨:٥٠ ص مرتبطًا برسالتها نفسها، وسجل تفاعلها يفتح على حدث حقيقي لها. وتصحيح رقم غير موجود يعيد ٤٠٤ ولا يخترع عميلًا — اختبرته على النظام الحيّ وعدد العملاء لم يتغيّر.
- **الحارس موصول ومُختبر.** كسرتُه عمدًا فأعطى FAIL وخرج بالرمز ١، وشغّلته حقيقيًا فمرّت ٧ مسارات بلا أخطاء. ومكتوب في CLAUDE.md وفي مهارة المجال معًا.
- **أدلة الصور صارت حقيقية لأول مرة.** أربع مقارنات بين ملفين مختلفين فعلًا، والأصفار الباقية كلٌّ منها يشرح سببه بصدق. ولقطة ٣٧٥ — الجولة الخامسة — تحتوي المرحلة الحالية فعلًا.

**ما يجب إصلاحه قبل العرض (بندان، لا يحتاجان إرسال أي رسالة):**
1. **المحادثات الأربع ما زالت تبدأ بـ«Proxy Massar».** الإصلاح منع تكرار المشكلة، لكنه لم ينظّف ما حدث: كل عميل حقيقي — ومنهم إبراهيم، صاحب الصفقة المكتسبة — ما زال سجل تفاعله يفتح على «هل تقصدون خدمة أو منتجًا باسم Proxy Massar؟»، وأحدهم يعرض «**بروكسي مسار**» بالنجمتين. هذا نصّ قلتَ عنه «this is not ok» وهو معروض على الشاشة التي ستعرضها. الحل عشرة أسطر عند العرض فقط، بلا حذف أي بيانات.
2. **«خدمة أخرى: ١ مكتسبة» على لوحة «لماذا نكسب ولماذا نخسر».** لوحة تحكم بالخدمات لا يمكنها إصدار حكم على خانة تعريفها «ليست خدمة». سطر واحد يزيلها — والعدد نفسه مفيد في مكان آخر: «٣ محادثات سألت عن خدمة خارج الكتالوج».

**تنبيه مهم:** تعليمك الجديد — لا إرسال أي رسالة واتساب لأي رقم، ولا حتى للاختبار، حتى تحدد الأرقام بنفسك — سُجّل كقاعدة دائمة، ويلغي استثناء «أرقام الفريق» القديم. كل بند في قائمة التصحيح أعلاه قابل للإثبات دون إرسال أي رسالة.
